limitations: No acoustic-reference recordings, perceptual score, or claim that every numerical change is an improvement.
Parameter digests include appended fields: a changed digest alone does not establish an audio change, including for both unchanged Init programs.

Normalized spectra, relative envelopes, crest and stereo correlation are invariant under ideal static linear gain above their numeric floors; output nonlinearity and all other changed controls can also affect them. These comparisons do not isolate causation.
Spectral measurements can use different peak-window positions before and after; they do not describe every part of the sound.
Three-second single-note holds do not cover full slow-pad development, performance range, voices, velocity/pressure curves, long effects tails, or all plugin/native builds.
Exactly equal aggregate metric vectors are not proof of sample-identical waveforms; tolerance counts address CSV rounding only, not audibility.

measurement_windows.spectrum: Hann-windowed summed left/right power around the loudest held window; DC excluded; low <500 Hz, mid 500..<2000 Hz, high >=2000 Hz.

method.relative_envelope: Body minus early RMS, tail minus body RMS, crest factor and loudest held-window time; ratios touching the -240 dB floor are null.

pressure_fixtures.status: validated; both programs produce non-silent finite audio at pressure=1

source_provenance.after_state: final-source development candidate; all four bank suites passed after two final calibration passes per bank; native qualification pending
source_provenance.qualification: Input/executable hashes and current source manifest are verified; the manifest associates the binary with source, but this script does not independently prove its compilation or qualify native plugin builds.

validation.sample_count_qualification: CSV contains no observed frame/sample count; these counts are derived from 48000 Hz * (3 s held + 1 s tail), not independently measured from WAV files.
